slice.title: Add supplier resource
slice.goal: Add Supplier as a second lightweight resource in the existing stock-enabled products-app without connecting products to suppliers yet.
acceptance_criteria: Existing product create, edit, list, search, category filter, stock quantity, availability filter, Adjust Stock action, and availability label behavior remains working.
User can create a supplier with name and contact email in the existing product catalog prototype context.
User can see newly created supplier records in the supplier management UI or supplier API response.
The slice adds supplier-owned model/service/API/storage/UI files without changing product-supplier relationships yet.
The incremental run extends the existing product catalog implementation rather than creating a separate unrelated app.
constraints: Use the previous adjusted-stock products-app run as the baseline via --from-run, for example runs/run-007-products-adjust-stock.
Preserve existing /api/products route and root ProductCatalogScreen.
Do not add supplier_id to Product in this slice.
Do not add supplier filter or supplier name display in the product list in this slice.
Add suppliers as a second lightweight resource: supplier model, supplier service, supplier API, supplier mock JSON, and compact supplier management widget are allowed.
No product delete or supplier delete behavior.
No purchase orders, contracts, procurement workflow, authentication, external integrations, database migrations, or new dependencies.
Continue using local JSON mock storage.
non_goals: Supplier contracts, scoring, procurement, or purchase orders.
External integrations or persistent database migrations.
notes: This is the first split supplier scenario. It adds only the supplier resource and supplier creation UI.
Incremental scenario. Use after a successful products-app-adjust-stock run, for example runs/run-007-products-adjust-stock.
